identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase 2 Study of Dacomitinib in NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single-arm, Open-label, Phase 2 Study of Dacomitinib With or Without Dose Titration for the First-line Treatment of Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-small Cell Lung Cancer in Subjects With an Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) Activation Mutation

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
This is a multi-national, multi-centre, single-arm, open-label, Phase 2 clinical study of the efficacy and safety of first-line treatment with dacomitinib, with or without dose titration, in subjects with newly diagnosed stage IIIB/IIIC/IV or recurrent EGFR-mutation-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

National Cancer Centre Singapore is the lead sponsor acting in a coordinating capacity and the rest of the participating sites are sponsors of their own individual sites.

conditions: EGFR Positive Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

interventions.name: Dacomitinib
interventions.description: 30mg of oral dacomitinib is administered daily for one cycle. After one cycle, a toxicity assessment will be conducted. Subjects will then continue dacomitinib at either 30mg or 45mg.

primaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of subjects with PFS at 12 months
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the start of treatment to the date of disease progression or death due to any cause at 12 months

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the start of treatment to the date of death for any cause, up to 3 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of subjects with a best overall response of either complete response (CR) or partial response (PR)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the start of treatment until disease progression, up to 3 years
From the start of treatment to the last dose of treatment, up to 3 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of subjects with a best overall response of either CR or PR of intracranial disease
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the start of treatment until disease progression, up to 3 years
From the start of treatment to the date of intracranial progression or death due to any cause, up to 3 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of incidences of adverse events
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From start of treatment to 28 days after end of treatment
